F 2 # i 3 e e 151 likes funlandmag In 1989 Iranian-American programmer Nasir Gebelli was forced to leave Japan, and the Squaresoft offices he worked at, over work visa issues. In the middle of programming Final Fantasy Ill, his coworkers wagered Nasir was so essential to Final Fantasy that it was more economic to move the entire crew to him than wait out another visa process. The rest of Final Fantasy Il was created in a motel room in Sacramento, California, as seen in this photo. 1989
